g.text: How customers consume it: APIs and the token meter
Every call is metered twice: against your quota, and on your bill.
input · cache write · cache read · output
Throttled, but the bill is small?
Throttling comes from the quota, cost comes from the bill. The same 1,000 output tokens burn 5,000 TPM but bill as 1,000.
Batch jobs go through the bedrock control-plane API instead (CreateModelInvocationJob, input and output files in S3).
